rationale: B is more actionable and facilitation-ready: it adds journey mapping, objection handling, explicit channel scoring, internal communication drafting, a launch dry-run, feedback loops, and hypothesis-based iteration. Its activities consistently specify usable techniques and produce execution-ready artifacts. It does have sequencing and timing weaknesses—KPIs arrive too late, channel-specific copy precedes channel selection, and several sessions exceed the stated three hours—but overall it provides greater operational depth and clearer handoff than A.
